---
name: Semantic ambiguity report
about: The contract left a mapping genuinely ambiguous and you refused to guess
title: "[ambiguity] "
labels: semantic-ambiguity
---

**Pinned release / commit**


**Event family and contract sections consulted** (e.g. OBSERVATION_EVENT;
sections 4.4, 6.4)


**The ambiguity**: what your input means, and the two or more ZMeta mappings
that each seem defensible


**What your adapter does today** (refuse-to-emit / non-canonical field /
namespaced extension; per the guide, never a guessed canonical mapping)


**What would resolve it** (a contract clarification, a policy knob, an
extension-registry concept, or just documentation)
